newsitem.title: USA: Idaho Power applies to form holding company.
newsitem.headline: Idaho Power applies to form holding company.

text.p: Idaho Power Co said this week it has filed with the Idaho Public Utilities Commission to form a holding company, which, if approved, will serve as the parent company of both Idaho Power Co and its subsidiary Ida-West Energy Co.

Idaho Power said in a newsletter it will also seek approval from necessary federal agencies and the public utilities commissions of Nevada, Oregon and Wyoming, where the company has holdings or conducts business.
A shareholders' vote will likely be taken at the company's May 1998 annual meeting.
Idaho Power chief executive officer Joseph Marshall said the proposed structure gives the company moe flexibility to meet future challenges.
The company presently has six wholly-owned subsidiaries, of which only one, Ida-West, will initially be placed under the holding company.

The other five, Steller Dyanamics, Idaho Power Resources Corp, Idaho Energy Rsources Co, Idaho Utility Products Co and Idacorp Inc, will remain subsidiaries of Idaho Power, although the company said it may in the future place one or more of them under the holding company.
Marshall said the proposed holding company would most likely be governed by the same board of directors as Idaho Power and administered by a small staff.
